name: Inductors, chokes and toroids
summary: Coils and chokes that store energy and filter noise: toroids, drum cores and common-mode chokes.
uses: Wire and ferrite cores for radio coils and transformers
identify: Copper wire wound on a ring (toroid), drum or bar, on power supplies, inverters, motherboards, LED drivers and amplifiers. Yellow and white toroids from PC power supplies are common.
test: A working coil reads low ohms. Look for burnt or cracked insulation and broken cores.
